summary: Added 27 unique, DOI/Crossref-verified primary empirical SLA/pedagogy studies to docs/research/supervisors/pedagogical-primary.json (93 -> 120 total), closing the pedagogy corpus's own >=100 evidence floor and, combined with the already-complete 127-study psychology corpus from LC-RES-Y04, bringing the overall two-domain supervisor evidence gate to READY. Four parallel research passes were run across distinct topic clusters (vocabulary/reading; task-based/pragmatics; motivation/age moderators; assessment/spacing/comprehension), each given an explicit DOI exclusion list drawn from the live corpus. The first round of four passes surfaced 25 candidates, but cross-checking every proposed DOI programmatically against the existing corpus caught 6 exact-DOI duplicates two research passes had missed (Mackey 1999, Loschky 1994, Iwashita 2003, and Gass & Varonis 1994 collided with PED-P01-006/PED-P01-020/PED-P02-003/PED-P01-019; Ellis Tanaka & Yamazaki 1994 and Leeman 2003 collided with PED-P01-022/PED-P02-021) -- all were dropped before entering the corpus. Three further candidates (Rose 2000, Bardovi-Harlig & Hartford 1993, House 1996) were dropped after this session's own independent WebFetch verification showed their exact sample sizes were not stated in any fetchable source, only corroborated by unfetchable secondary summaries, so per the no-invented-data rule they were excluded rather than included with an estimated N. A second round of two research passes (corrective feedback/grammar; fluency/task-based/pragmatics), given the updated exclusion list, surfaced 11 more candidates; one (Ammar & Spada 2006) turned out to be an exact-DOI duplicate of the existing PED-P01-005 and was caught and dropped by this session's programmatic cross-check before entering the corpus. Every one of the 27 accepted candidate DOIs was independently re-verified by this session directly against the live Crossref API during compilation (not just trusting each pass's self-report), and several were independently spot-checked by re-fetching their cited secondary sources (e.g. Bridgeman/Cho/DiPietro 2016 TOEFL-GPA correlations via ERIC EJ1104403; Ran/Wang/Zhu 2022 anxiety N via PMC9389700; Sato & Lyster 2012 N via ERIC EJ989384; Suzuki & Hanzawa 2022 N via Cambridge Core) confirming the quoted sample-size/population/outcome text matched. Two broken verificationSources URLs surfaced by this session's own link checks (an HTTP-only lextutor.ca link, and a Wiley page returning 403 with no working ERIC id) were replaced with confirmed working HTTPS alternates (a UTP Publishing DOI landing page; the correct ERIC EJ753072 record, found by re-searching) before finalizing.

evidence.frontend: cd linguachat-frontend && npm run check:all && npm run build && npm run check:i18n — exit 0, run twice consecutively clean on the final head (i18n: 7/7 locales at 100% coverage, 0 missing/extra/phMismatch)
evidence.backend: cd linguachat-backend && python -m compileall . && python -m pytest -q — exit 0 (444 passed), run twice consecutively clean on the final head
evidence.evidenceGatePartial: node .github/scripts/check-supervisor-evidence.mjs --partial pedagogical — pedagogical: 120 unique primary studies; 14 topics; partial gate passed
evidence.evidenceGateFull: node .github/scripts/check-supervisor-evidence.mjs — pedagogical: 120/100 unique primary studies, 14 topics; psychology: 127/100 unique primary studies, 14 topics; overall gate reports READY (100+100 unique, identity-verified, primary empirical studies)
